jobs.description:
Copenhagen (Nordhavn)

• Hybrid

• English working language

**About The Role

**Secomea builds secure remote access for industrial machines. Machine builders and manufacturers use our products to reach and service their equipment in the field without opening up the plant network. The portfolio runs from edge hardware (SiteManager) to our cloud platform, Secomea Prime.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who has built identity and access capabilities in B2B SaaS. You will own identity and access across our portfolio: who can reach which machine, when, with whose approval, and how every session is recorded. You take it from the customer problem to adoption. You report to the Director of Product Management and work in a small team of product managers and UX designers & researchers.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own discovery for your area. Talk to the people who buy and use our products: decision-makers at machine builders, distributors, IT and security leaders at end customers, service technicians, OT engineers and IT administrators. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements and outcomes.

• Decide on commercial grounds. Build the business case for your area (market potential, revenue impact, cost to build, margin) and back your priorities with usage data, win/loss insight and market analysis.

• Know the market. Track competitors, buying behaviour and technology shifts, and spot where Secomea can win.

• Run the roadmap. Plan your area 18 to 36 months ahead, with every theme tied to a customer outcome or a business metric.

• Work closely with engineering. Agree on scope and success criteria together. You own the what and the why; engineering owns the how and estimates the effort.

• Manage the full lifecycle. Weigh new capabilities against the health of live, mission-critical deployments. Set release support windows, end-of-life plans and migration paths for legacy products.

• Keep security and regulation in the plan. IEC 62443 (especially identification, authentication and use control), the EU Cyber Resilience Act and NIS2 shape requirements and release gates for our customers and for us.

• Measure the outcome. Define and track KPIs such as adoption, retention and time-to-value, and use them with customer feedback to decide what comes next.

• Get releases product-ready for go-to-market. Product Marketing owns pricing, packaging, enablement and launch communication. You give them the product input they need: what changes, for whom, why it matters, and the data behind it.

**What You Bring

**

• 6+ years in product management, with a substantial part on a B2B SaaS product.

• Product experience with identity and access management, for example single sign-on, user provisioning, role-based permissions, approval workflows or privileged access.

• Products you took from discovery to launch and kept improving.

• Ownership of a business case or revenue target, and an example of a decision that moved a commercial number.

• Comfort with data: you run your own analyses rather than wait for a report.

• Clear writing, and experience making a case with evidence to engineering, sales and leadership.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience with OT, industrial automation, Industrial IoT or remote access.

• Experience with products that combine cloud, software and hardware.

• Working knowledge of identity standards such as SAML, OIDC and SCIM.

• Working knowledge of IEC 62443, CRA or NIS2.

**This role is not for you if…

**

• You have never managed a B2B SaaS product. OT, hardware or security expertise alone is not enough for this role.

• You see product management as coordination, backlog administration or writing detailed user stories. Our PMs start at the customer problem, set the outcome, and work out the details with the team.

**Why join Secomea?

**At Secomea we rely on initiative and an open mindset, where your creativity and dedication come to use in an open and positive work atmosphere. As we are fast-growing and constantly expanding our business, you will have plenty of chances to grow your responsibilities and competencies while working at the heart of contemporary industrial tech.

We are a truly diverse company with offices placed across the globe, 30+ different nationalities, embracing all genders.

• Your own area. The product team is small, so you own your area end to end and your decisions show up in the product.

• Good timing. CRA and NIS2 raise the bar for remote access in industry, and AI is changing how access is audited and threats are detected. You will help decide how Secomea responds.

• An international team. More than 30 nationalities, with offices in Denmark, China, Japan and North America.

**How to apply

**In your application, describe one product decision you based on data and what it did to revenue, retention or cost.

About the Role

Following our acquisition of Active Key, we are looking for a Product Manager to take end-to-end ownership of our medical and hygienic hardware portfolio. In your first year, you will establish portfolio coherence across multiple international channels and markets, defining what we sell and why, mastering our SKU strategy, and bridging German engineering with our commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities:

You will be part of our Product Management, working alongside your 4 colleagues, while reporting directly to our Head of Product Management. In this role, you will collaborate closely with our engineering, marketing, and commercial teams across Europe

• Portfolio Architecture & SKU Strategy: Establish clear segmentation and tiering across the medical portfolio, mapping what we sell and why for clinical users and buyers across four channels and more than a dozen markets. Own the market-by-market SKU matrix (layouts, connectivity, finishes, certifications).

• Product Master Data: Act as the single source of truth for all product data, technical specifications, product descriptions, attributes, and compliance documentation across internal functions and external channel partners.

• Lifecycle Governance: Run the portfolio review cadence to manage structured SKU rationalization, phase-in/phase-out timelines, end-of-life (EOL) decisions, and migration paths for existing customers.

• Engineering & Commercial Interface: Serve as the two-way bridge with our German engineering team: translating clinical market realities and customer needs into functional requirements, while bringing technical feasibility, costs, and manufacturing capabilities back to sales and marketing.

• Clinical Discovery & Healthcare Requirements (PRDs): Conduct fieldwork across hospitals and healthcare environments to observe infection control and workstation realities (shared terminals, mobile carts/WOWs, virtual desktops). Translate these user workflows, user needs, and compliance requirements into structured Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

• Commercial Ownership & Business Cases: Author and own the financial business cases for all portfolio updates and introductions, including market opportunity sizing, pricing logic, margin targets, and sales volume forecasts.

• Go-To-Market Alignment: Partner with the rest of the departments to ensure our product portfolio and value proposition are clearly articulated to channel partners and clinical customers.

What we are looking for:

• Hardware Product Management: Min. 3 years of product management experience managing physical products or hardware portfolios through their complete lifecycle, from concept and launch to phase-out.

• Portfolio & Variant Management: Practical experience managing variant-rich product lines across multiple B2B sales channels and international markets, including SKU rationalization, portfolio mapping, and master data accuracy.

• Healthcare or Clinical Context: Prior experience in medical devices, clinical IT, healthcare environments, or relevant B2B/public sector hardware is strongly preferred.

• Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong business mindset with hands-on experience modeling business cases, analyzing product margins, and defining pricing structures.

• User Discovery & Workflow Analysis: Practical experience conducting field discovery, observing end-user friction in real environments, and synthesizing findings into functional requirements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to build trust and work constructively with technical engineering teams while representing commercial realities.

• Languages & Travel: Fluent in English, with professional working proficiency in German as a strong advantage; open to international travel to our other offices & production sites (Germany and Asia), and clinical customer sites across key markets.

What We Offer:

• Direct Portfolio Ownership: End-to-end ownership of our medical and hygienic portfolio with direct visibility to leadership and a clear mandate to create operational impact.

• Professional Growth: The opportunity to build portfolio management craft within an evolving, international workplace health company.

• Central Location & Hybrid Setup: A modern office right by Vesterport Station in Vesterbro, with flexible work-from-home options.

• Benefits & Wellbeing: A strong pension scheme, gym allowance, and regular monthly team breakfasts every first Friday and Friday bars every other month.

The Recruitment Process

All applications will be reviewed and responded to on an ongoing basis. We expect to begin interviews in week 42, with interviews held on a rolling basis throughout the period. Employment start date is expected to be earliest 1 December or 1 January, depending on the notice period of the successful candidate.

What to Expect in the Recruitment Process

• Screening: A short phone call with our HR Manager (15–20 minutes)

• 1st interview: With the HR Manager and Hiring Manager (60 minutes)

• 2nd interview: With the HR Manager and Hiring Manager. You can also expect to meet our Product Manager for Active Key online via Teams during this interview.Ahead of this interview, we will ask you to prepare a case and complete a personality profile, which we will use during the interview (90 minutes)

• Skip-level interview: Teams call with the VP of Marketing (30-40 minutes)

• Job offer

About Contour

We are on a mission to make the world a healthier place to work. Headquartered in Copenhagen with 30 years in business, Contour designs and develops ergonomic workplace equipment. We invented the RollerMouse, and 9 out of 10 users report our products helped relieve their pain.

Following our acquisition of Active Key, we combine ergonomic design with specialized hygienic peripherals. We are actively expanding our portfolio and commercial presence across Europe and North America.

We are a team of around 110 people globally, large enough to have international reach, yet small enough that your work is visible, owned, and directly felt across the business.

All contact will be treated with confidentiality. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of their background and identity. Our inclusion policy applies to all employment practices within the organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Contour makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact our HR team at hr@contourdesign.com.

Are you our new Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology?

AudienceProject is looking for a Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology for our Copenhagen office to support our continued growth.

—

Are you a quantitative researcher who enjoys working with data about people? And are you interested in how panels and surveys can make audience measurement more reliable? Then, we have an opportunity for a career in a fast-growing scale-up with 100+ employees that collaborates directly with companies such as Heineken, L’Oréal, LVMH, Omnicom Media, Publicis Media, WPP Media, Amazon, Google, Netflix, RTL and Warner Bros. Discovery.

AudienceProject is a leader in independent cross-media measurement, enabling advertisers, media owners and the industry to trust, prove, and improve advertising outcomes through a scalable SaaS platform.

Our platform provides advertisers with a unified view of campaign performance, enabling confident omnichannel investment decisions, and provides media owners with comparable, third-party validation to demonstrate the value of their inventory.

After more than 15 years of leading cross-media measurement, we are now looking for a motivated Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology to join our Data Science Research team.

Joining AudienceProject will give you a front-row seat in the rapidly evolving advertising industry and an opportunity to work within a respected business, delivering insights about audiences across the world's largest media channels to top-tier clients.

What you will do

You will join our Data Science Research pod, led by Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen, and help turn panel and survey data into reliable audience measurement. Our panelists are recruited through several panel partners. They contribute passive measurement data through integrations and take part in surveys that help calibrate our models. You will work with 10 other data scientists and engineers, bringing together a range of academic and professional backgrounds.

Your focus will be quantitative analysis, panel quality and statistical methodology. You will use Python to investigate data and develop reproducible analyses, working closely with researchers and engineers to improve the inputs and methods behind our measurement.

We actively explore and apply AI in our internal work, production systems and products, combining experimentation with sound analytical judgement. You will help evaluate promising approaches with data scientists and developers and turn useful ideas into practical improvements.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Analyse panel composition and coverage across partners, identifying differences, gaps and potential sources of bias.

• Assess the completeness, consistency and plausibility of passive measurement data, and investigate unexpected changes.

• Design and analyse surveys that describe panelists and their behaviour and provide data for model calibration.

• Contribute to the development and evaluation of weighting, calibration, and statistical modelling approaches, testing how methodological choices affect audience estimates.

• Identify survey-response quality issues and assess the trade-off between stricter quality rules and retaining a representative sample.

• Clean, combine, and analyse panel and survey datasets in Python, with clear documentation of assumptions, methods and limitations.

• Work with panel-partner colleagues, data scientists, and engineers to turn findings into practical data-quality improvements and evaluate their effect.

Who you are

You combine strong quantitative skills with curiosity about how people are represented in data. You enjoy tracing an unexpected result back to its source, questioning assumptions and explaining what the evidence supports. Your background may be in statistics, quantitative social science, economics, psychology, data science or another relevant field.

You bring:

• Strong skills in quantitative analysis and applied statistics, including regression, sampling, uncertainty and model validation.

• Hands-on Python skills to clean, explore and analyse real-world data independently and make your work reproducible.

• An understanding of panels and surveys, including representativeness, selection bias, non-response and measurement error.

• A careful approach to data quality and the ability to judge how data issues affect an analysis or model.

• The ability to explain methods and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• A relevant quantitative education or equivalent applied research experience.

Useful additional experience includes weighting, calibration or passive behavioural data.

We value thoughtful analysis, openness to different perspectives and colleagues who share what they learn. You ask questions, test assumptions and explain your conclusions clearly.

What we offer

You will join a curious, collaborative and energetic environment where data scientists and developers share ideas and learn from one another. Different perspectives help us ask better questions and improve how we measure audiences.

Our social calendar offers plenty of opportunities to get to know colleagues, with activities you can choose to join. There is room to contribute your ideas, take on meaningful research questions and develop your skills with the support of colleagues.

• Competitive salary

• Pension scheme and health insurance

• Home internet paid

• Central Copenhagen office

• International environment

• Friendly, supportive and helpful colleagues

• Innovative and market-leading products and services

• Real-world panel and survey data, with research questions about quality, representativeness and uncertainty

• The opportunity to improve the statistical methods behind independent audience measurement

• Working directly with some of the most modern and successful companies of our time

Send us your application

We welcome different routes into data science. If this role interests you and you bring relevant quantitative and Python skills, we would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen at jacobh@audienceproject.com. Attention: applications and documents sent via email will not be considered.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

They will be critical in enabling cost-efficient deployment of large-scale renewable energy to achieve energy security and to reach ambitious global decarbonization targets, while maintaining cost competitiveness of the energy system. Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

• Build and mature the investment cases for the CEI project you work on

• Own the project financial model and ensure that the model is maintained and used consistently across the projects

• Be the CEI focal point for our (joint venture) partners

• Manage the processes related to joint ventures, fund raising, divestitures; including negotiation of agreements and transaction documents

• Develop insights and high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders

• Advise CEI leadership team regarding general corporate matters such as portfolio management and resource allocation considerations

• Support CEI fundraise activities, including managing certain workstreams

• Play an active role in origination of new project opportunities and develop in-depth understanding of target markets

• You will help to manage, train and develop the Managers, Associates and Analysts, and will contribute to the positive, professional and collegiate working environment

• Participate in our activities to grow the team, such as interviewing and ranking candidates.

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

• You are proactive, think ahead and stay hands-on.

It is the expectation that frequent presence in Copenhagen is necessary for success.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

We’re looking for a Product Engineer to help us build better tools for legal research. You’ll work mainly on the backend, with a say in what we build and responsibility for taking it from an early idea to something customers use every day. That includes asking whether we’re solving the right problem, deciding what’s worth shipping first, and knowing when something needs more time.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**What We Value

**“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Mess Around. Find Out. Share What You Learned.

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

You enjoy working through a product problem while it’s still taking shape. You ask questions, share unfinished work, and help decide what’s worth building. You’re comfortable taking a feature from those early conversations through implementation, testing, and delivery.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

If you’re energised by leading people and complex technical projects and you thrive in a changing, multidisciplinary environment, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Manager of AIT Project Management to join our AIT Project Management leadership team. As a team, we are working on some of the largest and most technically complex pharma projects in Denmark, using the latest technologies across Automation and IT.

Together with the AIT Project Management leadership team, you will lead and develop a department of 15 Project Managers delivering highly technical projects in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. Your contribution will be important in ensuring high performance and employee wellbeing, while securing the right resources and competencies for our growing project portfolio.

You will work closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support business development, follow up on new opportunities and ensure the right staffing across our projects. You will also contribute to creating a positive and engaging working environment across our wider team of more than 50 highly skilled Project Managers.

Our Project Managers bring experience across Process Automation, SCADA, PLC, IT/OT, PI, PAT, MES, and automated solutions. Project execution ranges from traditional PMP-based planning and execution to agile methodologies and the use of ADO, depending on the project area and customer requirements.

How you might spend your days

As a Manager of AIT Project Management, you’ll be:

• Leading, coaching, and developing a motivated team of Project Managers, ensuring high employee engagement and wellbeing

• Ensuring the right resources and competence mix are in place to support our growth strategy and project pipeline

• Working closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support project delivery, business development, and new opportunities

• Strengthening Project Management processes within AIT and driving continuous improvements

• Supporting project execution and, when needed, taking on smaller assignments as a Project Manager

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A supportive leader who listens, provides constructive feedback, and motivates others to succeed

• Committed to ongoing coaching and the wellbeing and development of your employees

• A team player who leads by example and collaborates effectively across different areas and levels

• A strong communicator with a positive, holistic, and analytical mindset

• Structured and effective in your work, with an open and engaging management style

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or bring equivalent relevant experience

• You have at least four years of experience leading Project Managers and/or technical specialists

• You have a background as a Project Manager

• You have knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry

• You are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 25th October 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact VP of AIT Project Management Timme Traberg-Andersen +45 3079 9436.

Please note:

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Planetary is looking for a Managing Director (Fondsdirektør) to lead Planetary A/S and the continued development of its two investment funds: Planetary Impact Ventures and Planetary Soil Fund.

At Planetary, we invest in companies and farmland aligned with our guiding principles. We invest in companies with a focus on long-term business models within planetary boundaries, and in degraded farmland and partners who are committed to soil regeneration. Our commitment is manifested in our evergreen structure. Our focus is biodiversity, agriculture and food, and we aim to provide a fair financial return. We want to inspire and contribute to a restructuring of our economic systems, a redefinition of what value is, and increase our understanding and reconnection with nature and life on the planet.

At Planetary, our work does not stop with investments. Our theory of change is focusing on a systemic and broad approach. We work to nourish and contribute to the community around us. We believe that value alignment between investors, us as intermediaries, and our portfolio companies is essential to the success of our shared mission. These principles are instrumental to the way we work – and who we are.

The role

As Managing Director, you will have the overall responsibility for Planetary A/S, ensuring strong governance and compliance, performance and development of the funds. You will report to the Board, and work closely with all the people working at Planetary.

Your work will be grounded in a deep commitment to systems change and a transition towards organic-regenerative food and agriculture.

Key responsibilities

Planetary and organisational leadership

·      Lead and develop Planetary’s organisation and its two funds in close collaboration with the Board, the active Partners, the Investment Committees and Fund Directors.

·      Take responsibility for Planetary’s financial management, budgets and allocation of resources.

·      Lead fundraising and relationships with LPs and key stakeholders.

·      Take responsibility for company-level reporting and compliance in coordination with our fund directors.

·      Ensure strong governance, transparent Board reporting and effective follow-up on decisions.

·      Ensure that Planetary’s impact objectives are integrated into investment strategy, portfolio management and decision-making across both funds.

·      Lead according to the culture rooted in Planetary’s values, combining intellectual curiosity, courage and humility with collaboration, care for people and planet, sound commercial judgment and high standards.

Together with the Fund Directors

·      Support the investment teams, ensuring sound investment practices, high-quality investment decisions and effective collaboration with the Investment Committees and the Board.

·      Support founders and management teams of the companies where Planetary can contribute experience, perspective and network.

·      Maintain oversight of portfolio performance, risks, opportunities and capital requirements.

·      Take board roles in portfolio companies.

You have:

·      Experience with investing.

·      Proven track record in operational leadership and business development.

·      Strong analytical and financial management skills.

·      Experience in people leadership and organisational development.

·      Good communication, interpersonal skills and stakeholder management abilities.

·      A deeply rooted commitment to contributing to a healthier planet.

You are likely to have:

·      Several years’ experience from venture capital, impact investment, private equity or another relevant investment environment.

·      A solid understanding of fund economics, fund raising, portfolio performance and investments.

·      An understanding of impact management and the integration of financial and impact objectives.

Experience within food and organic-regenerative agriculture is an advantage, but not a prerequisite. Commitment to transforming the food system towards a more regenerative and resilient future is essential.

The right candidate

You are an experienced leader with a strong understanding of investments and of how capital can contribute to systemic change.

You combine sound judgement and the ability to create momentum with curiosity, collaboration and humility. You enjoy working in a small organisation where people remain close to the work and are motivated by long-term development.

__________________________________________________________________________

Location

Our office is at an organic farm in Humlebæk.

Timeline and application

**Finance Business Partner, VELUX A/S - Østbirk

****Do you enjoy turning data into meaningful insights and working closely with people to influence decisions and drive performance? With a passion for business partnering and a strong analytical mindset, you could be our next Finance Business Partner in Østbirk.

****Meet your future team

**As part of our Global Finance team, you will join a group of dedicated and experienced colleagues supporting our production sites in Østbirk and Brædstrup. Together, we work to bring financial insights to life and enable informed business decisions that create value across the organisation.

In this role, you will work closely with operational leaders, managers, and finance stakeholders, building trusted relationships and gaining a deep understanding of our manufacturing business. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing, openness, and continuous learning, creating an environment where everyone can contribute and develop their skills.

**What We Offer

**As Finance Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting business performance and helping operational teams make data-driven decisions. You will have the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment where your expertise and insights contribute directly to business success.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Partner with managers and operational teams to provide financial insights and decision support.

• Monitor and analyse efficiency, production performance, material consumption, budgets, and key operational KPIs.

• Prepare financial analyses, business cases, and presentations to support strategic and operational decision-making.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and monthly reporting processes.

• Contribute to standard costing and product costing activities within a manufacturing environment.

• Develop and enhance reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, efficiencies, and value creation.

• Communicate financial information clearly and effectively to stakeholders across different functions and levels.

**What You Will Bring

**We are looking for a collaborative and curious finance professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking with strong business understanding. Whether your background is in Finance Business Partnering, Controlling, Financial Analysis, or a related field, you are motivated by creating value through insights and strong stakeholder relationships.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Have strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights.

• Build positive and productive relationships with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Have advanced Excel capabilities and an interest in reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI.

• Communicate fluently in both Danish and English.

• Work in a structured and organised manner while remaining flexible and solution-oriented.

• Thrive in a collaborative environment where teamwork and knowledge sharing are highly valued.

• Bring experience with SAP, standard costing, or product costing, although this is considered an advantage rather than a requirement.

If you do not meet every requirement but believe your experience and potential make you a strong candidate, we encourage you to apply. We recognise that diverse experiences and perspectives strengthen our teams and contribute to better outcomes.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Project Manager with a background in medical device development? Do you enjoy leading complex development projects and coordinating work across internal teams and external development partners? Then you may be the Project Manager we are looking for in EndoIntelligence Solutions within Global R&D.

In this role, you will lead a strategically important development project and work closely with a global and cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution from planning through delivery.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Project Manager, you will:

• Lead a cross-functional development project through all phases of the product development process.

• Drive project planning, execution, follow-up, and reporting of scope, timeline, budget, risks, and key decisions.

• Coordinate activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders.

• Manage and maintain strong collaboration with external development partners and suppliers.

• Facilitate project governance activities, including Steering Committee reviews and decision-making forums.

• Ensure project documentation and deliverables are completed in accordance with Ambu's quality system and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Create transparency, alignment, and engagement across the project team and stakeholder landscape.

• Support the continuous improvement of project management practices and lessons learned.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the perfect candidate cannot be defined on paper. However, you are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Hold a technical degree within engineering or a related field.

• Have experience leading the development of complex medical device hardware, including electronics, mechanics, embedded systems, and integration across disciplines.

• Have worked closely with external development partners and suppliers and understand how to manage outsourced development activities, technical deliverables, timelines, and risks.

• Have experience working with internal and external development teams across different regions, including Asian and European countries, and bring the cultural awareness needed to adapt ways of working and build effective collaboration across cultures.

• Are comfortable navigating a complex stakeholder environment and driving alignment across functions.

• Bring a structured and proactive approach to project execution and risk management.

• Have strong communication and leadership skills and enjoy working with international teams.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**At Ambu, you will become part of an international organization with ambitious growth plans and a strong innovation agenda. We work in cross-functional teams and value collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while developing your professional and personal capabilities in a dynamic environment.

As an Atlassian Platinum Partner (multiple-time Partner of the Year), two-time GitHub Partner of the Year (EMEA), and Azure Managed Service Provider, we empower organizations across Cloud, DevOps, Agile, and AI-powered transformations. Curious about a role where you can make a real difference to production planning? As our End-to-End Planner, you will connect Operations, Procurement and Commercial—turning complex supply challenges into clear plans and informed decisions.

**The role

**You will own operational and tactical planning for relevant production lines, help balancing production, purchasing, inventory and customer needs. You will also contribute to a stronger, globally consistent planning processes.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Managing the full planning horizon in SAP ePPDS, from operational to tactical levels, including placing purchase orders with suppliers

• Maintaining and acting on SAP exception reports daily, managing process orders and due dates, and addressing risks to order fulfillment and stock levels in the monthly S&OP process

• Planning specific production lines in Frederikssund while ensuring alignment with global operations. Develop and maintain production plans while keeping a global overview.

• Owning the monthly Sales & Operations (S&OP) supply reviews for your lines, presenting data-driven insights, imbalances and trade-off scenarios

• Optimizing inventory and safety-stock levels, and support continuous improvement of planning processes

After your first year, success will mean that production lines have clear plans for order volumes and start/end dates. Decision-makers can make aligned, fact-based decisions, and risks to order fulfilment or inventory are identified, escalated and addressed in time.

**What You Bring

**We expect that you have some years of practical experience with integrated supply chain planning, ideally in process industry or a technology-service environment. You have obtained knowledge of the S&OP cycle and supply planning for finished goods and/or raw materials, probably in a production environment.

Strong proficiency in SAP ePPDS, APS solutions, Business Warehouse, Excel and PowerPoint.

As a person you have a structured, analytical approach, you pay attention to detail and have the ability to turn complex data into clear decision-making material. You succeed in your stakeholder management because of your strong communication and collaboration skills and the confidence to work across functions.

On the more formal side, you hold a relevant academic technical engineering, Supply Chain Management or Economics degree.

Fluency in written and spoken English, as well as Danish, is a prerequisite.

The role requires physic presence in Lyngby and Frederikssund.

**Why join us

**You will have a hands-on role with a broad view of the planning process—from daily operational decisions to tactical supply planning. Your analyses and recommendations will help balance production, purchasing, inventory and customer delivery needs.

jobs.occupation: HR Business Partner, Strategic Marketing and International Sales
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HR Business Partner who thrives in a dynamic international environment? Do you enjoy partnering with senior leaders, translating business priorities into people strategies, and driving organisational effectiveness through strong HR partnering? And are you motivated by supporting commercial organisations where leadership, talent and culture play a critical role in business success? Then you might be our new HR Business Partner for Strategic Marketing and International Sales at Demant Diagnostics.

Driving people and business success across Strategic Marketing and International Sales

As HR Business Partner for Strategic Marketing and International Sales, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and leadership teams, helping translate strategy into practical people and organisational solutions. You will support two business functions, each led by its own Vice President and operating with different priorities, organisational structures and ways of working.

In this role, you will partner closely with leaders to strengthen organisational effectiveness, leadership capability, employee engagement and business performance. You will be responsible for ensuring that people priorities are closely aligned with business goals while supporting the execution of the broader Diagnostics and global Demant people agenda.

Meet your new team and manager

The Diagnostics HR team acts as a close partner to leaders and the organisation, enabling strong performance, development and engagement across our global Diagnostics business. We work at the intersection of people, business and organisational development, ensuring that HR initiatives create value for both leaders and employees.

Our team values trust, development and continuous improvement. We combine strategic HR partnering with pragmatic execution and take pride in delivering professional, high-quality support across a diverse and international organisation.

The position is reporting to Kirsten Schmidt, Senior Director Diagnostics HR, and is based at the Demant Diagnostics Headquarters in Smørum, Copenhagen. We offer flexibility to work from home when business needs and tasks allow.

Global HR partnering supporting a growing business area

The HR Business Partner will play a key role in supporting leaders through organisational changes, helping navigate complexity, manage stakeholder expectations and create sustainable business solutions.

You will collaborate with HR colleagues and business stakeholders across functions, countries and organisational levels to ensure consistent and effective implementation of HR initiatives.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Partner closely with the Vice Presidents and leadership teams within Strategic Marketing and International Sales

• Act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on leadership, organisational and people-related matters

• Coach and challenge leaders to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team performance

• Drive and support organisational development, capability building and change initiatives

• Drive and facilitate initiatives to ensure alignment between business priorities and global HR processes.

• Lead talent and succession discussions, supporting the identification, development and retention of key capabilities

• Use people insights and workforce data to support informed decision-making and organisational planning

In addition, you will support organisational reviews, workforce planning and employee engagement initiatives while contributing to a positive, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**Your qualifications & experience

**

We imagine that you will bring a combination of:

• Solid experience as an HR Business Partner supporting leaders and commercial organisations in a complex business environment

• Relevant degree within human resources, business administration, organisational psychology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience advising and influencing leaders on organisational, talent and people matters

• Experience driving organisational change, leadership development and talent management initiatives

• Strong understanding of core HR disciplines and employment practices

• Experience working in an international and matrix-based organisation

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

• Experience supporting senior leaders or executives

Bringing solid business acumen, sound judgement and a collaborative approach to all your stakeholders will provide you with a great foundation for this role. Furthermore, you are comfortable balancing strategic priorities with operational execution and have the confidence to challenge constructively while building trusted relationships across the organisation.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to join a global organisation where people, leadership and business performance are closely connected. You will work with experienced leaders, influence strategic people agendas and contribute to shaping the future organisation across Strategic Marketing and International Sales.

Ready to join Demant Diagnostic’s HR team?

Then send your application and CV in English as soon as possible but no later than 8th of November. Please note we only accept application via our application system.

1st interviews will be conducted on the 17th of November

We aim to conduct 2nd interviews on the 24th of November

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

About Demant Diagnostics

Demant’s diagnostics business is a trusted diagnostic solutions provider in the field of hearing and balance assessment. This group of international companies develops, manufactures, and markets a wide variety of technological solutions globally, delivering instruments, software, training, and services that support the entire diagnostic journey – from early screening to advanced clinical assessment and balance treatment. Our portfolio includes well-known brands such as Maico, Interacoustics, Amplivox, GSI Grason-Stadler, MedRx, Audioscan, and Inventis.

Our products are sold in more than 100 countries through an extensive network of sales companies and distributors.

For more information, please visit: www.demant.com.
